rationale: After peaking at $109.41, the stock has formed a sequence of lower highs and lower lows over the last five 1-minute candles and slipped below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($109.00). With only 32 minutes remaining in the session and upward momentum fading, closing the position locks in the modest gain rather than risking a late-day pullback to the $108.15 invalidation level. An outright short flip is not warranted given the strong 5.57x relative volume and price remaining well above session VWAP ($105.75).
